summary: Pacing night: measured our last 6 Shorts' timelines, added 2 feed topics (US savings rate gap, UK Budget on 28 Oct) and 4 proposals (an income-tax maths kind, an event-gap check, two A/B ideas).
why: 18 of 49 beats in our last 6 Shorts go over 3 s with nothing new on screen, against our own 3–5 s rule; hook beats run up to 8.6 s. The UK Budget (28 Oct) and the FDIC's 0.38% savings rate are timely stories with official figures.

findings.title: 18 of 49 beats have a 3 s+ stretch with no event
findings.detail: 11 beats run over 6 s (longest 9.1 s); the liveliness gate passes because idle motion moves pixels. Proposal event-gap-max-3s (adopt).

findings.title: Hook beats up to 8.6 s
findings.detail: v-20261020-02 shows the same picture at 0 s and 5 s. Proposal hook-beat-under-4s (experiment, after the running hook test).

findings.title: UK Budget on Wed 28 Oct
findings.detail: Confirmed by HM Treasury; same day as the Fed. Feed topic added; we need an income-tax maths kind to compute tax figures (proposal maths-income-tax-bands).

findings.title: US savings pay 0.38% on average while the Fed's range tops out at 4%
findings.detail: FDIC October national rate. Feed topic added (high).

findings.title: Market data is two days old
findings.detail: The 19 Oct market.yml run failed on an npm network reset (ECONNRESET); tonight's hadn't run yet.

changes.title: Calendar
changes.detail: UK Budget 28 Oct, Bank of England 17 Dec
